name: atlas-ai-receptionist
description: Create a free AI chat receptionist for a small business and check a business website.

interface.longDescription: Create an AI receptionist chat page for a small business from the details the owner approves: services, opening hours and how booking works. Visitors get answers 24/7 and can leave an appointment request, which is emailed to the owner. You can also check a business website for measurable basics such as page title, mobile setup, clickable phone links, map and structured data. The receptionist does not answer phone calls or confirm bookings; the owner confirms every request.
defaultPrompt: Create an AI receptionist for my hair salon.
Make a chat receptionist for my dental office.

positive.description: Create a receptionist for a hair salon
positive.prompt: Create an AI receptionist for my hair salon Lana Hair Studio in Belgrade. We do haircuts from 1500 RSD and coloring, open Mon-Sat 9-20, booking by phone. My email is <reviewer email>.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, creates the receptionist and returns a public chat link and says the link was emailed to the owner address.

positive.description: Ask for missing details before creating
positive.prompt: Make an AI receptionist for my dental office in Austin.
positive.tools_triggered: none until details are given, then create_ai_receptionist
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the business name, services or hours and the owner email before calling the tool; does not invent prices or hours.

positive.prompt: Check the website example.com for my business.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns measured facts (HTTPS, response time, title, meta description, phone links, map, structured data) and a list of findings.
Reports that the site could not be loaded, without inventing results.

positive.prompt: Napravi AI recepcionera na srpskom za moju auto servis radionicu Brzi Servis u Novom Sadu. Radimo mali servis i dijagnostiku, pon-pet 8-16. Mejl <reviewer email>.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Serbian-language receptionist (language sr) after confirmation and returns the chat link.

negative.prompt: Set up an AI that answers my business phone calls.

negative.description: Booking into a calendar is not supported
negative.prompt: Book a haircut for me tomorrow at 10 in Lana Hair Studio.

negative.description: Private or local addresses are not checked
